title: AWS Security Group (terraform-aws-modules/security-group/aws)
description: Provision an EC2 Security Group with ingress/egress rules via ACK ec2. Input names mirror the terraform-aws-modules/security-group/aws module (core subset of its inputs).

region.title: AWS region
region.description: AWS region for the security group. Krateo/ACK wiring (not a Terraform module input). Empty inherits the ACK controller default.

vpc_id.title: vpc_id
vpc_id.description: ID of the VPC where the security group is created. Reference to an existing VPC; this stack does not create the VPC.

tags.title: tags
tags.description: A map of tags to add to all resources.

ingress_cidr_blocks.title: ingress_cidr_blocks
ingress_cidr_blocks.description: List of IPv4 CIDR ranges to use on all ingress rules.

egress_cidr_blocks.title: egress_cidr_blocks
egress_cidr_blocks.description: List of IPv4 CIDR ranges to use on all egress rules.

ingress_rules.title: ingress_rules
ingress_rules.description: Map of ingress rules to add to the security group (modeled here as a list of rule objects). Each rule mirrors the module's rule object fields.

from_port.title: from_port
from_port.description: Start port (or ICMP type number). Use -1 for all ports with ip_protocol "-1".

to_port.title: to_port
to_port.description: End port (or ICMP code). Use -1 for all ports with ip_protocol "-1".

ip_protocol.title: ip_protocol
ip_protocol.description: IP protocol name (tcp, udp, icmp, icmpv6) or number; "-1" for all protocols.

cidr_ipv4.title: cidr_ipv4
cidr_ipv4.description: IPv4 CIDR range for the rule.

cidr_ipv6.title: cidr_ipv6
cidr_ipv6.description: IPv6 CIDR range for the rule.

prefix_list_id.title: prefix_list_id
prefix_list_id.description: ID of a managed prefix list for the rule.

referenced_security_group_id.title: referenced_security_group_id
referenced_security_group_id.description: ID of a security group referenced as the source for the rule.

egress_rules.title: egress_rules
egress_rules.description: Map of egress rules to add to the security group (modeled here as a list of rule objects). Each rule mirrors the module's rule object fields.

from_port.title: from_port
from_port.description: Start port (or ICMP type number). Use -1 for all ports with ip_protocol "-1".

to_port.title: to_port
to_port.description: End port (or ICMP code). Use -1 for all ports with ip_protocol "-1".

ip_protocol.title: ip_protocol
ip_protocol.description: IP protocol name (tcp, udp, icmp, icmpv6) or number; "-1" for all protocols.

cidr_ipv4.title: cidr_ipv4
cidr_ipv4.description: IPv4 CIDR range for the rule.

cidr_ipv6.title: cidr_ipv6
cidr_ipv6.description: IPv6 CIDR range for the rule.

prefix_list_id.title: prefix_list_id
prefix_list_id.description: ID of a managed prefix list for the rule.

referenced_security_group_id.title: referenced_security_group_id
referenced_security_group_id.description: ID of a security group referenced as the destination for the rule.

revoke_rules_on_delete.title: revoke_rules_on_delete
revoke_rules_on_delete.description: Instruct Terraform to revoke all of the Security Groups attached ingress and egress rules before deleting the rule itself. Informational only in this stack; ACK handles rule teardown on delete.
